chung.Description: The purpose of this course is to equip students with the detailed understanding and knowledge of the package. It will also equip students with the essential practical and technical skills necessary for packaging design. Scope of evaluation will include target customers, brand language, personality and persuasion, concept creation, colour application, ergonomics, layout design, print finishing and materials... The challenges of designing for the future will also be considered; ensuring that environmental and ethical issues relating to the packaging industry are measured and applied.
chung.StudentTasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final examination.
- Actively participate in class activities.
- Fulfil tasks given by the instructor after class.
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes. Computers have to have some version of design software installed, such as Photoshop or Illustrator for design assignments, and PowerPoint for presentations.
- Read the textbook in advance.

Reviews of packaging available on the market:
- Instructors will divide the group according to the number of students (about 6 students per group)
- Each group will draw a lottery to receive a packaging sample that is being sold on the market (prepared by teacher).
- Student's mission: Analyze their team's products in terms of the advantages and disadvantages of the product: structure, sustainable design, aesthetics, usability, safety, display content, colors, meeting the needs of consumers ... At the same time offering better solutions.
From there, the teacher will consider and analyze more deeply the general aspects of the packaging of each selected group.

Assignment 2: Developing the Structural System of Primary & Secondary Packaging
(multiple weights/flavors), at actual scale, using real or closely simulated materials (surface graphics not yet designed). Minimum of 3 different SKUs (e.g., 250g/500g/1kg or Flavor A/B/C).
Deliverables:
1. A physical set of packaging prototypes at actual size, using real or closely simulated materials (without surface layout design).
2. A PDF file documenting the process of AI application and evidence of personal adjustments during the project development.
Requirements:
- The packaging structure must include the following components:
+ Primary packaging: the container in direct contact with the product (box/bag/bottle), at accurate capacity and real size.
+ Secondary packaging: the outer layer containing the primary unit (outer box/sleeve/tray), optimized for display and stacking.
+ Materials: equivalent to production-grade (e.g., duplex/ivory/kraft paper, corrugated carton, PET/PP). If not available, use the closest possible simulation.
+ Die-cut/dieline: with clearly indicated dimensions, folds, and glue flaps.
